description: Send listEmailReceiving's `to` list as one comma-separated query parameter (`?to=a@example.com,b@example.com`). The spec declares it `style: form, explode: false` and says "Repeating the parameter returns a 422 validation_error", but the shared OpenAPI converter drops `explode`, so the SDK would send `?to=a&to=b`. The trait maps to core `T.CommaDelimited` in scripts/generate.ts.
